entries.reason: the request is made for a MAP FEATURE -- the 16.4 header's designated initialiser is -initWithMapFeatureAnnotation: and +new is unavailable -- and a map FEATURE is a thing the map itself knows about, and this release's map has none: MKMapFeatureAnnotation is registered absent for that reason, so there is no feature for a request to resolve
entries.effect: -cancel, -cancelled and -loading are real: a running request that was asked to stop; -getMapItemWithCompletionHandler: answers with the header's own error in MKErrorDomain saying the map has no features to resolve, and NOT with a made-up place. A release whose map does have features resolves it properly and nothing here stands in its way
entries.source: apple.objc.inventory against the armv7 dyld shared cache of 6.1.3: the release's own MKMapItem carries -placeID, -placemark, -initWithPlacemark: and -openInMapsWithLaunchOptions:, and MKLocalSearch is first exported at 6.1, and apple.dyld's first_releases, which puts MKMapItemRequest at 16.0
